		<h1 class="entry-title"><span class="dsgvo-number">Recital 18 </span><span class="dsgvo-title">Not Applicable to Personal or Household Activities*</span></h1>
	</header><!-- .entry-header -->

	<div class="entry-content">
		<p><sup>1</sup>This Regulation does not apply to the processing of personal data by a natural person in the course of a purely personal or household activity and thus with no connection to a professional or commercial activity. <sup>2</sup>Personal or household activities could include correspondence and the holding of addresses, or social networking and online activity undertaken within the context of such activities. <sup>3</sup>However, this Regulation applies to controllers or processors which provide the means for processing personal data for such personal or household activities.</p>
				<div class="title-disclaimer"><p>* This title is an unofficial description.</p></div>
